en: This isn't everyone...right?
...Kaito and Kokichi aren't here.
...I bet Kokichi is already there.

As the mastermind of the killing game,
he's waiting for us to arrive.

We...don't know that yet.
There's still a chance Kaito is alive.
...Cut it out. Do you want to die?
Maki...

This is a battle between <CLT=cltSTRONG>hope<CLT=typeNORMAL> and <CLT=cltSTRONG>despair<CLT=typeNORMAL>. If I
show any weakness like you are...
...then I know I'll lose to <CLT=cltSTRONG>despair<CLT=typeNORMAL>.
<CLT=cltMIND>Lose to despair...

Six of us will participate, and one of us will
die after this class trial...
Then only five will be left. Only...five...
Th-That's right... We're...the only ones left...

But we can't lose to <CLT=cltSTRONG>despair<CLT=typeNORMAL>. Even if we
have no future, we need to win.
That is...the whole point of this class trial.

I will defeat Kokichi, no matter what I
have to sacrifice.

<CLT=cltMIND>No matter what she has
to sacrifice?
<CLT=cltMIND>Are you sure about that, Maki?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that what you call "<CLT=cltSTRONG>hope<CLT=cltMIND>"?
<CLT=cltMIND>I know that we can't lose to <CLT=cltSTRONG>despair<CLT=cltMIND>.

<CLT=cltMIND>But...something is wrong.
Something doesn't feel right.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what Kaito would say
at a time like this.
<CLT=cltMIND>What would he say to us?
<CLT=cltMIND>If it was Kaito...
Let's go.

No matter what Kokichi is scheming, there's
no way we can lose.

...After all, we're students of Hope's Peak
Academy.
I-I'm fine. I'll be on my guard the whole time.

I'm filled with the combined power of
<CLT=cltSTRONG>hope<CLT=cltNORMAL> and magic right now!

I'll defeat Kokichi, no matter what I have
to sacrifice. We can't lose...

Shuichi...I understand you don't want
to believe it, but...
Kaito's...not here anymore.
<CLT=cltMIND>I know that we can't lose to <CLT=cltSTRONG>despair<CLT=cltMIND>.

<CLT=cltMIND>But...something is wrong.
Something doesn't feel right.
<CLT=cltMIND>...What is hope?
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?
<CLT=cltMIND>I know that we can't lose to <CLT=cltSTRONG>despair<CLT=cltMIND>.

<CLT=cltMIND>But...something is wrong.
Something doesn't feel right.
<CLT=cltMIND>...What is hope?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*rumble rumble rumble!*
<CLT=cltMIND>We didn't say a word to one another.

<CLT=cltMIND>Silent as a tomb, we stepped
into those open doors.

<CLT=cltMIND>We had lost the will to live, knowing what
we know about the outside world.

<CLT=cltMIND>But somehow...despite that despair,
we had found a new reason to live.
<CLT=cltMIND>To win <CLT=cltSTRONG>the battle between hope and despair<CLT=cltMIND>.

<CLT=cltMIND>But now...
What do we know?

<CLT=cltMIND>We don't know what <CLT=cltSTRONG>hope<CLT=cltMIND>
means to us anymore.

<CLT=cltMIND>What is <CLT=cltSTRONG>hope<CLT=cltMIND>...?
A burden you bear?

<CLT=cltMIND>As those thoughts pierced my
mind, I suddenly stopped.
<CLT=cltMIND>I can't think about things like that anymore.

<CLT=cltMIND>The only thing I need to think about...
is survival.
